_note: Contacts (phone book) v1 data, dev only, behind ?contacts=1 (Coder, Oct 23 2026; Gary 12:24 PM CT asked for a trainer contact system for named trainers; quote in dev_notes). Structure only: no player text here (Text Bot owns it under system_contacts in text/overworld_lines.json; see data/textbot_requests_contacts.md). Keys are '<map>.<npc id>'. Only trainers listed here can become contacts; generic class-named trainers and hall helpers/Masters are refused unless their block says contact: true. A map NPC def may also carry its own contact block (def.contact), which wins over this file. All numbers are Coder defaults pending Gary.

ping._note: Incoming pings. A ping can only fire on a fresh tile step, outside battles / dialogue / scripts / cutscenes / menus / fades, after the map has settled. Steps and game minutes both have to pass since the last ping; then a per-step chance; at most maxPerDay per in-game day. Contacts on the player's current map never ping (they are right here).

1._note: Rematch level cap for region 1 = Master 1's ace level minus one (master_fernwick ace_level 12; region 1 non-Master trainers stay under 12), so a rematch never out-levels the region's Master; tests/contacts.test.mjs cross-checks it against data/masters.json and data/region_pulls.json.

fernwick.ron_rival_1._note: Ron is the story rival: his battles come from the story, so no phone rematches (open question for Gary).
